steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each term's effect is matched to its volume source. A saving counted twice is flagged.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

outcome.verdict: 1 effect uses a volume with no source

findings.title: Effect uses a volume with no source
findings.fix: Name the volume source before the budget is set

findings.title: Term starts after the budget year
findings.fix: Move the term or the budget

outcome.notChecked: Whether the budget is affordable at group level.

pros: Checks a line whose effect uses a volume with no source, a term that starts after the budget year, and a line that counts the same saving twice.
cons: Not checked: Whether the budget is affordable at group level.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-neg-budget-impact skill on the records for this review.
